title: FDA Proposes Rule to Modernize Drug Manufacturing Registration
excerpt: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today issued a proposed rule that, if finalized, would create a streamlined registration pathway for distributed manufacturing establishments that operate as a single establishment using a “hub-and-spoke” model.
